current_source_tree.method: SHA-256 of UTF-8 lines <file-sha256><two spaces><repository-relative-path><LF>, sorted by path; hash each current file bytes.
current_source_tree.scope: git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard -- apps/mobile packages/stera_recorder; regular files only; includes unstaged source adaptations and new locks/project configs, excludes ignored generated/private files.

source_only.copy_selection: git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard, current bytes; ignored artifacts/raw captures/old submodule and private env excluded. No .git, .dart_tool, build output, app .env or initialized submodules in copy before checks.
source_only.toolchain: standalone checksum-verified SDK from scripts/platform/install-mobile-toolchain.py, pinned JDK; dependency caches reused

source_only.analysis: both clean, including retained recorder example
source_only.recovery: Add retained example/pubspec.lock; all eight commands then pass under set -e on a source-only copy with generated Flutter/Gradle state and env/local.properties removed before retry.

monorepo_full.execution: Real applicable full Nx graph, including current mobile/example locks, Flutter tests/analyzers, native host tests/instrumentation assembly, Android x64 app build, Node/Python/tooling checks and format gates. Local Nx cache enabled for deterministic unchanged checks; APK and prepare targets uncached.
monorepo_full.scope_note: Completed before six inherited source-format omissions were corrected. Focused uncached full-source format and staged hook validate that formatting-only follow-up; no broad runtime/build repeat.

affected_graph.method: Nx show projects --affected --files=<path> --json, without target-scoped pruning
affected_graph.explanation: .nxignore anchors /stera-app/ so retired checkout is excluded without hiding third_party/stera-app provenance. Ignored .env is not an input; generated .kotlin is ignored/excluded from source hashes even when explicitly supplied artificial --files queries select its containing project.

final_source_format.coverage: All Git-visible Dart and hook-supported config/docs, including tools, examples and assets JSON; generated-state directories excluded. App292Dart files and recorder21Dart files checked.
final_source_format.reason: Installed staged hook exposed six inherited source formats outside prior lib/test checks; corrected using the shared Dart language3.9/Prettier policy. Formatting-only follow-up; prior runtime/build results remain scoped to pre-format source.

limits: No emulator or physical device was used for SA-10.
